## Why visit

A purposeful Warrington stop for traditional pub character and beer variety, especially if mild or darker cask styles appeal. The former Peter Walker pub retains stained glass and separate lounge/vault spaces, giving the visit more personality than a generic town-centre bar. CAMRA’s current description reports a substantial rotating guest range with dark styles normally represented. It makes sense as a carefully planned break on a journey through Warrington or as a short dedicated outing, rather than a reason to string several scattered towns into one day. Allow time to sit and compare styles.

## Beer

CAMRA’s August 2026 record reports nine rotating guest ales, usually including dark mild and stout or porter.
